meanings.visual: Three asterisk units arranged in a triangle.
meanings.semantic: Marks a major break between sub-chapters or narrative sections.
meanings.engineering: Treat preceding and following blocks as separate sections; do not merge context across the break.

accessibility.name: Asterism
accessibility.description: Indicates a major section or narrative break.

ai.intent: Preserve hard section boundaries in documents.
ai.llmInstructions: Treat :asterism: as a major structural break. Do not blend requirements, decisions, or narrative across the mark; summarize each side separately when asked.
recommendedPrompts: Summarize the sections before and after :asterism: separately.
List decisions that belong only to the block after :asterism:.
ai.engineeringContext: ADRs with distinct phases, runbooks with major scene changes, long-form design docs.

usage.recommended: Separate major narrative or document sections when a new heading is too heavy.
usage.notRecommended: Do not use for soft paragraph decoration—prefer :hedera:.
